title: GOVERNED WORKLOAD AUTHORITY COURT
finite_holding: Current Rawlsing has a mixed and incomplete workload law. Governing law establishes a reconstructibility requirement for future-authorized empirical conjunction/query frontiers, and bounded V550J joint-configuration authority establishes an authority-selected subset workload. It does not establish a global MATERIALIZE_ALL_PERMITTED law, and it does not establish family-specific workload selectors for most base V550 diagnostics/conditionals, the current attitude-cloud pair universe, historical branch-conditioned cotravel, or V550J association candidate calculation.

A_MATERIALIZE_ALL_PERMITTED.holding: Semantic/use permission is not a workload command. No located current law converts every allowed_as_* permission into mandatory materialization. The governing economy law expressly allows diagnostic recomputation on demand and says canonical storage need not mirror every exploratory calculation.
A_MATERIALIZE_ALL_PERMITTED.exception_note: Within an invoked governed V550J run, selected joint configurations have required output-family coverage. This conditional compiler contract is not a global all-permitted materialization law.

B_RECONSTRUCTIBLE_ON_DEMAND.holding: Same-respondent incidence or an information-equivalent source substrate must remain reconstructible where future-authorized queries need it, so separately authorized conjunctions can be computed without assuming independent marginals determine joint reality. This is a requirement on empirical queryability/replay frontier, not a command to persist every current diagnostic artifact.

C_AUTHORITY_SELECTED_SUBSET_ONLY.holding: The executable V550J joint registry plus accepted authority releases selects bounded source/wave/configuration families and can admit JOINT_ONLY variables. Most base V550 families do not have an equivalent family-specific workload selector.

cloud_workload_ruling.d04_f01_consequence: Current order dependence is not, by itself, proof of a workload-law violation because exhaustive materialization is not established. It remains an implementation incompleteness relative to an exhaustive run if such a workload is separately selected.
cloud_workload_ruling.d04_f05_consequence: Pre-registration resource gating is not authority to define the lawful pair universe; whether it may omit a permitted pair from today's workload remains unresolved without a pair-selection law.

The exact scoped question/field/predicate/pair/configuration members that are required workload when the family is not already bounded by the V550J joint registry.
Whether required work is precomputed/materialized, reconstructible/on-demand only, or not evaluated absent an explicit request/selection.
